HumanItemSample.description: An explicit sample bundle, validated before any query or action.

HumanItemDetail.description: An item and its complete affected-node list.

history.description:
Every event the journal recorded for this item, oldest first: who took
each action, when, and whose words it was. The engine's own reading of
its journal; a reader never derives it again from `events.ndjson`.

provenance.description:
Whose words it is: the manager's own, or the user's relayed. Omitted while
it is the manager's, and absent from every record written before the field
existed, which reads as the manager's.

Provenance.description: Whose words a ruling is. Serialized as the lowercase word; absent, `manager`.

The manager's own ruling: a strong default a dispatch may decline with its
reason. What every record written before this field existed reads as.

HumanItemHistoryEntry.description: One event of an item's history, as [`HumanItemDetail::history`] lists it.

at.description: When it was recorded, as RFC 3339.

actor.description:

PhaseContext.title: PhaseContext
PhaseContext.description: What a phase supplies when it raises.

schema_version.description:
The contract version the writer declares, if any. It is carried as given
and never gates what the context may hold: a ticket title is accepted
whatever it says, or with none. Omitted again when absent.

dedup_key.description:
The phase's own identity for this occurrence; the item's dedup key is
derived from it and the phase.

node.description: The node a work hold binds, for a hook whose block is `work`.

vars.description: Template variables for the title and body.

approval.description: The document version a design review completes against.

HumanItemOwner.description: The originating session and optional run and plan.

HumanItemApproval.description: An opaque approval authority reference captured when raised.

Ticket.description: One ticket a review phase aggregates.

id.description: The ticket's id; the last occurrence of an id wins.

priority.description: Its priority, absent or `none` when it has no usable one.

title.description:
Its title, the text the review links it by; absent, it is linked by its
short repository reference. Optional and omitted when absent, so a context
written before it existed is read unchanged.
